faehigkeiten.grund: Auslieferung wird je Abruf neu zusammengesetzt (megaphone vergibt je Abruf eine request_event_id, megaphone haengt ein timetoken an, Adresse traegt eine session_id, kein ETag und Cache-Control "max-age=0, no-cache, no-store", Abruf laeuft ueber den Werbedienst megaphone.fm) - Byte-Offsets veralten (bei dynamischer Auslieferung sofort, gemessen 19.08.2026) und die Zeitachse verschiebt sich mit (eine Folge war 57 s kuerzer als 3,5 h zuvor), deshalb sind auch Sprungmarken in Sekunden unsicher; Texte aus dem Begleittext des Podcasters, kein Transkript - ohne Zeitachse sind Clips und Sprungmarken unmoeglich

einzeiler: The history and fall of the Achaemenid Persian Empire.
kurzfassung: This episode explores the rise of the Achaemenid Persian Empire from the ruins of a previous world. It examines how the empire constructed its grand palaces and monuments, and managed relations with other ancient peoples. Finally, it looks at the events that led to the destruction of the Persian royal palaces.
stichpunkte: The emergence of the Achaemenid Persian Empire on the Iranian Plateau
Construction of grand palaces and monuments
Unification of diverse populations within the empire's borders
Relations, conflict, and cooperation with other ancient peoples
The destruction of the Persian kings' palaces
beschreibung:
In the highlands of the Iranian Plateau, a collection of enormous pillars reach up to the sky...
In this episode, we tell the story of the Achaemenid Persian Empire. Find out how this remarkable ancient power sprung up from the rubble of a ruined world to become the most powerful human society on earth. Hear how they raised their grand palaces and monuments, and brought an unprecedented number of people together within their borders, as well as coming into conflict and cooperation with other ancient peoples. And finally find out what happened to bring the palaces of the Persian kings crashing down in fire and flame.
